REVOLUTION D.F. X FULLY MODULAR ATX POWER SUPPLIES
INTEL ATX 3.0 & PCIe 5.0 READY!
The REVOLUTION D.F. X series meets the Intel ATX 3.0 specification with a native PCIe 5.0 600W 12VHPWR cable providing stable and reliable power to your next-generation graphics cards including NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 40 Series.
THE MOST ADVANCED PERFORMANCE
The REVOLUTION D.F. X meets all the Intel ATX 3.0 standards including up to 200% power excursion which ensures consistent and reliable power delivery to your graphics cards during intensive gaming or overclocking sessions, and 70 % efficiency in 2% loading as well as less than 200ms power-on time.
200%
Power Excursion
< 200ms
Power-on Time
POWER UP WITH 600W 12VHPWR CABLE
With the arrival of PCIe 5.0, the native 600mm 12VHPWR cable can deliver up to 600W of power from the 12VHPWR connector to the latest graphics cards and avoid overloading with single rail +12V design.
EXTRA CABLE FOR MULTIPLE USAGE
The REVOLUTION D.F. X helps you get ready for the future with another 600mm adaptor cable with dual 8-pin PCIe connectors for PSU side and 12VHPWR connector for GPU side, it allows you to build with flexibility.
Dual 8 pin to 12+4 pin (12VHPWER) cable
* Please be aware of the total wattage requirement when you connect more than 1 GPU.
HOW TO PROPERLY PLUG THE 12+4 PIN 12VHPWR CABLE TO PREVENT DAMAGE
Use your fingers to hold both sides of the cable and insert the cable into the port straight in line with the port. Make sure to insert the cable firmly and evenly straight in without any gaps or bending under 40mm from the plug downwards.
LIGHT IT UP WITH ARGB SIDE PANEL
To stand out from all the ATX 3.0 power supplies, the REVOLUTION D.F. X comes with an ARGB side panel with built-in 14 lighting modes. It supports synchronization with supported motherboard software.
RGB ON/OFF WITH RGB CONTROL BUTTON
The RGB control button next to the power switch allows you to turn it off at night with one push. You can also switch directly between the built-in 14 lighting modes via the RGB control button.
A FAN WITH VERSATILITY
DUST-FREE ROTATION HIGH PRESSURE BLADE DESIGN SEMI-FANLESS WITH 0 dB(A) 6-POLE MOTOR DUAL-BALL BEARING
DUST-FREE ROTATION TECHNOLOGY ENSURES A STABLE POWER DELIVERY
With ENERMAX’s patented Dust-free Rotation technology, which is an innovative self-cleaning solution that enables the fan to blow away dust upon powering on, it ensures the REVOLUTION D.F. X remains clean, prevents any future disruption, and ensures a stable power delivery for years.
HIGH-PRESSURE BLADE DESIGN
With the high-pressure blade design, the fan blades centralize dispersed airflow to the center of the fan and create extremely high air pressure and high airflow while maintaining outstanding quietness.
SEMI-FANLESS TECHNOLOGY FOR ABSOLUTE SERENITY
The semi-fanless technology allows the fan to be completely off until the load exceeds 20% or over-temperature to create a 0 dB(A) environment and ensure a quiet operation during minimum load.
6-POLE MOTOR FAN INSIDE FOR MINIMAL VIBRATION
The REVOLUTION D.F. X has been optimized with a 6-pole motor with 3-phase fan to provide minimal vibration, low power consumption, and an exceptionally smooth operation.
INDUSTRIAL-GRADE DUAL-BALL BEARING
The REVOLUTION D.F. X is equipped with a high-performance fan featuring industrial-grade dual-ball bearings, which effectively reduces unnecessary friction to optimize its performance. By incorporating these high-quality dual-ball bearings, the REVOLUTION D.F. X achieves enhanced stability and exceptional quality. This design not only extends the lifespan of the unit but also maximizes the performance of your system for your most demanding needs.
OUTSTANDING PERFORMANCE
SUPERIOR EFFICIENCY
SUPERIOR EFFICIENCY EXTEND YOUR PC’S LIFESPAN
As the efficiency becomes more and more crucial for the environment, the REVOLUTION D.F. X is 80 PLUS® Gold certified with efficiency over 90% on standard loading, which reduces unnecessary power consumption during operation and effectively saves energy.
INDUSTRIAL-GRADE 100% JP CAPACITORS
INDUSTRIAL-GRADE 100% JAPANESE CAPACITORS
Offering the best of the best to our customers, the REVOLUTION D.F. X uses industrial-grade 100% Japanese capacitors to ensure power output is extremely stable and reliable for years.
BETTER REGULATION
TECHNOLOGIES FOR BETTER REGULATION
The REVOLUTION D.F. X applied advanced LLC and Synchronous Rectifier (SR) design which resulted in better regulation, low noise, and low output ripple and improved efficiency and thermal management.
HEAVY-DUTY PROTECTION
HEAVY-DUTY INDUSTRIAL-GRADE PROTECTIONS
Over Current Protection
Over Voltage Protection
Under Voltage Protection
Over Power Protection
Over Temperature Protection
Short Circuit Protection
COMPACT 140MM FOR FRIENDLY INSTALLATION
REVOLUTION D.F. X is one of the smallest high-wattage power supplies with a compact 140mm-depth size, providing more options for friendly installation in 99% of mainstream cases.
ENERMAX UNIQUE AIR GUARD FOR BETTER AIRFLOW
The ENERMAX air guard will benefit the cooling performance while decreasing the fan noise with the wider space of the air inlet.
CABLE AND POWER AS YOU NEED
Only connect the cable you need with fully modular design.

Notice:For users that are looking to put in high end, power demanding GPU card, please connect 6 / 6+2P PCIe connector(s) from your ENERMAX power supply to them correctly. This will prevent motherboard overloading and possibly cause damage to your system including your ENERMAX power supply. Once this occurs, it will be treated as improper system configuration and any damage on the power supply as a result of it, will not be covered under ENERMAX manufacturer’s warranty. Please refer to your motherboard & GPU card’s user manual to configure your system properly to prevent motherboard overloading damage to your system and your power supply.
Either sleeved or flat type modular cables in the box are all compatible with your newly purchased power supply. Please only use the modular cables provided in your ENERMAX power supply package. Do NOT use other modular cables to prevent pin configuration damage to your system and your power supply.
Info for DC connector’s rated current: The safety current is 6A per single DC wire. Please be noted that overloading could cause the connector or wire meltdown and could void the warranty.
